summary: Workforce Option A is undergoing real-cycle validation during the live submission cycle.
Workforce Option B remains blocked pending Workforce Option A's real-cycle evidence.
Resident email/login is live and stable; treat as protected during the current submission cycle.
Institutional Auth is specified but implementation remains architecture-review gated, not automatically the next slice.
Tenant DB-level SELECT/column confidentiality remains open and is deliberately deferred pending Institutional Auth.
Any future supervisor/consultant/examiner assessment is a separate external-assessment primitive, not layered onto rubric_instances.
Assessor identity integrity on rubric_instances is at-most-one-of (assessor_workforce_id, assessor_doctor_id), not exactly-one-of.
The shared submission-status deterministic core is implemented and used by both Compliance Nudges and submissionChaserAgent.
Scheduled/delivery automation is a future layer, not yet built.
Modularization Phase 4A-4D (tenant-domain, announcements, exam-readiness, viva-simulator service extraction) is completed locally and paused.
